method: Three rounds of 5 random generated items per chapter (45 items each, 135 in all, across bank, practice forms and mocks) re-solved by hand: every numerical recomputed from the stem data, every fact/MCQ key checked against NCERT Chemistry XI
fixes: ASCII hyphen used as minus sign in thermochemistry and electrochemistry stems (now true minus throughout)
redox skeleton equation dropped H2O2 when stripping H2O (balancing item for MnO4-/H2O2)
Delta U values for Delta H = Delta U + Delta n RT now near real values for each reaction (previously random magnitude and sign)
generic case/long templates switched off for the spontaneity table and Lassaigne table where they read awkwardly
oxidising-agent MCQ family split from the written identify-all family; classification items typed short (2 marks)
Kc-expression and isotope-pair distractors that could duplicate the answer are rejected
note: No wrong answers found; fixes were wording/format and two generator bugs found while sampling. Bank regenerated and revalidated after the fixes.
